cards.english_title: Experts Discuss Lee’s Pragmatic Diplomacy
cards.korean_desc: 전문가들은 한국의 기술과 산업 역량을 외교 영향력으로 바꿔야 한다고 말했습니다. 또한 협력국에 실제 혜택을 줘야 한다고 강조했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Experts said South Korea should turn its technological and industrial strengths into diplomatic influence. They also stressed providing real benefits to partner countries.
cards.hook: Can technology become Korea’s diplomatic superpower?

cards.english_title: Kim Calls for the Strongest Army
cards.korean_desc: 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 지휘관 회의에서 최강의 군대를 만들라고 촉구했습니다. 그는 평양에서 군 지휘관들을 만났습니다.
cards.english_desc: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un called for building the strongest army at a commanders’ meeting. He met military commanders in Pyongyang.
cards.hook: A military meeting, but Kim’s message was crystal clear.

cards.english_title: US Activates Air Defense Unit in Guam
cards.korean_desc: 미군이 괌의 미사일 방어를 강화하기 위해 방공대대를 새로 배치했습니다. 북한과 중국의 위협에 대비하기 위한 조치입니다.
cards.english_desc: The US military activated an air defense battalion in Guam to strengthen missile defenses. The move responds to threats from North Korea and China.
cards.hook: Guam gets a new shield against missiles.

cards.korean_title: 유엔, 한국의 케냐 헬기 기부에 감사
cards.english_title: UN Thanks Korea for Kenya Helicopter Donation
cards.korean_desc: 유엔 고위 관계자가 한국의 케냐 헬리콥터 기부에 감사를 전했습니다. 헬리콥터 8대는 유엔 평화유지 활동을 지원합니다.
cards.english_desc: A senior UN official thanked South Korea for donating helicopters to Kenya. The eight helicopters will support UN peacekeeping operations.
cards.hook: Eight helicopters, one big peacekeeping boost.

cards.english_title: Hana Financial Reports Record Profit
cards.korean_desc: 하나금융그룹의 올해 첫 9개월 순이익이 3조 6200억 원으로 사상 최대를 기록했습니다. 자사주 매입과 소각도 크게 늘었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Hana Financial Group posted a record net profit of 3.62 trillion won in the first nine months of the year. Share buybacks and cancellations also increased sharply.
cards.hook: Hana’s profits soared—and shareholders noticed.

cards.english_title: Woori Financial Profit Tops 1 Trillion Won
cards.korean_desc: 우리금융그룹이 2분기 연속으로 분기 순이익 1조 원을 넘겼습니다. 올해 첫 9개월 순이익은 2조 6600억 원입니다.
cards.english_desc: Woori Financial Group topped 1 trillion won in quarterly profit for the second straight quarter. Its net profit for the first nine months was 2.66 trillion won.
cards.hook: Woori keeps crossing the trillion-won line.

cards.korean_title: 서울 증시, 저가 매수로 소폭 상승
cards.english_title: Seoul Stocks Edge Up on Bargain Hunting
cards.korean_desc: 서울 증시는 전날 큰 폭으로 하락한 뒤 소폭 상승했습니다. 투자자들은 반도체 주식을 저가에 사들였습니다.
cards.english_desc: Seoul stocks edged higher after falling sharply the previous day. Investors bought semiconductor shares at lower prices.
cards.hook: After a market stumble, bargain hunters went shopping.

cards.korean_title: 노후 IT 시스템, 보안 위험 커져
cards.english_title: Groups Warn of Aging IT Security Risks
cards.korean_desc: 주한미국상공회의소와 시스코가 오래된 IT 시스템의 보안 위험을 경고했습니다. 한국 기업들은 시스템을 현대화해야 한다고 촉구했습니다.
cards.english_desc: AmCham Korea and Cisco warned about security risks from aging IT systems. They urged Korean companies to modernize their systems.
cards.hook: Old computers may be inviting new trouble.

cards.english_title: Jinyoung Makes the Case for Reading Slowly
cards.korean_desc: 가수 진영은 반복적인 연예계 생활로 지쳐 책을 읽기 시작했습니다. 그는 천천히 읽으며 생각이 다시 활발해졌다고 말했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Singer Jinyoung began reading after becoming tired of the repetitive entertainment lifestyle. He said reading slowly helped his thoughts become active again.
cards.hook: Sometimes, slowing down is the fastest way to think.

cards.english_title: Inside Seoul’s Multimillion-Won Coffee World
cards.korean_desc: 서울의 한 카페에서 한 잔에 최대 350만 원인 고급 커피를 판매합니다. 매우 희귀한 원두와 맞춤형 추출법을 사용합니다.
cards.english_desc: A Seoul café sells luxury coffee costing up to 3.5 million won per cup. It uses extremely rare beans and customized brewing methods.
cards.hook: How luxurious can one cup of coffee become?

cards.english_title: Deborah Turbeville’s Photos Capture Strange Glamour
cards.korean_desc: 데버라 터빌의 사진은 흐릿하고 낡은 듯한 분위기를 보여줍니다. 사진 속 모델들은 유령처럼 멀리 있는 느낌을 줍니다.
cards.english_desc: Deborah Turbeville’s photographs show a blurry, decaying atmosphere. The models seem distant, almost like ghosts.
cards.hook: These glamorous photos seem to remember their own ghosts.

cards.english_title: Justin Bieber Visits Seongsu
cards.korean_desc: 저스틴 비버가 자신의 브랜드를 홍보하기 위해 서울 성수를 찾았습니다. 그의 패션·라이프스타일 브랜드는 성수에 첫 팝업 매장을 열었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Justin Bieber visited Seoul’s Seongsu to promote his own brand. His fashion and lifestyle brand opened its first pop-up store there.
cards.hook: Bieber returned to Korea—this time with a business plan.

cards.english_title: Korea to Face Saudi Arabia and Qatar
cards.korean_desc: 한국 축구대표팀이 11월에 사우디아라비아와 카타르와 평가전을 치릅니다. 두 경기는 카타르 도하에서 열립니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korea’s football team will play friendlies against Saudi Arabia and Qatar in November. Both matches will take place in Doha, Qatar.
cards.hook: Two Gulf tests await the Taegeuk Warriors.

cards.english_title: Cho Eun-hye Wins Para Fencing Gold
cards.korean_desc: 조은혜가 아시안 패러게임 여자 개인 에페 B에서 금메달을 땄습니다. 한국이 이 대회 펜싱에서 금메달을 딴 것은 처음입니다.
cards.english_desc: Cho Eun-hye won gold in the women’s individual epee B event at the Asian Para Games. It was South Korea’s first fencing gold at the Games.
cards.hook: A one-point victory made history.

cards.english_title: Oosthuizen to Leave LIV Golf
cards.korean_desc: 2010년 브리티시 오픈 우승자인 루이 오스틴하우젠이 LIV 골프를 떠납니다. 그는 이번 결정이 인생에서 가장 어려운 결정 중 하나라고 말했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Louis Oosthuizen, the 2010 British Open champion, will leave LIV Golf. He said the decision was one of the hardest of his life.
cards.hook: A major champion is changing courses off the course.

cards.english_title: Bayern Draw 2-2 with Arsenal
cards.korean_desc: 바이에른 뮌헨이 아스널과 2-2로 비겼습니다. 한국 수비수 김민재는 선발 출전했지만 전반전만 뛰었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Bayern Munich drew 2-2 with Arsenal. South Korean defender Kim Min-jae started but played only the first half.
cards.hook: Kim played half; the teams shared the whole drama.

cards.english_title: Lisa Releases New EP Press Play
cards.korean_desc: 블랙핑크의 리사가 6곡이 담긴 새 EP ‘Press Play’를 발표했습니다. 타이틀곡 ‘Tarantino’의 뮤직비디오는 영화 같은 액션을 보여줍니다.
cards.english_desc: Blackpink’s Lisa released her six-track EP Press Play. The music video for lead single Tarantino features cinematic action.
cards.hook: Lisa presses play—and enters a movie-like mission.

cards.english_title: BTS’s Swim Reaches 1 Billion Streams
cards.korean_desc: BTS의 노래 ‘Swim’이 스포티파이에서 10억 회 재생을 넘었습니다. 2026년에 전 세계에서 발표된 곡 중 처음으로 이 기록을 세웠습니다.
cards.english_desc: BTS’s song Swim surpassed 1 billion Spotify streams. It became the first song released worldwide in 2026 to reach the milestone.
cards.hook: BTS just swam past a billion streams.

cards.english_title: Santos Bravos Announces Anniversary Release
cards.korean_desc: 라틴 팝 그룹 산토스 브라보스가 데뷔 1주년을 맞아 11월 20일 신곡을 발표합니다. 이번 곡은 지난해 협업 싱글 이후 처음 나오는 신곡입니다.
cards.english_desc: Latin pop group Santos Bravos will release a new song on November 20 for its first anniversary. It is the group’s first new release since last year’s collaboration single.
cards.hook: One year old, and Santos Bravos already has a sequel.

cards.english_title: Aoora Headlines Indian Festival Finale
cards.korean_desc: 인도 뭄바이에서 활동하는 한국 가수 아우라가 인도 음악축제의 마지막 무대에 섰습니다. 그는 자신의 노래와 말라얄람 인기곡을 불렀습니다.
cards.english_desc: Korean singer Aoora, based in Mumbai, headlined the finale of an Indian music festival. He performed his own songs and popular Malayalam hits.
cards.hook: A Korean voice brought the festival finale to life.

cards.korean_title: PHP 보안 결함에 해킹 시도 급증
cards.english_title: Hacking Attempts Surge After PHP Flaws Found
cards.korean_desc: PHP의 심각한 보안 결함이 공개되자 해킹 시도가 급증했습니다. 기업과 정부는 서둘러 시스템을 점검하고 패치를 설치했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Hacking attempts surged after critical PHP security flaws were disclosed. Companies and governments rushed to check their systems and install patches.
cards.hook: A software flaw opened a worldwide race against hackers.

cards.english_title: Korean-Language Education Expands Overseas
cards.korean_desc: 2025년 해외 한국어 수업 수강생은 19만 1896명으로 5년 전보다 약 50% 늘었습니다. 47개국의 2777개 학교에서 한국어를 가르쳤습니다.
cards.english_desc: In 2025, 191,896 students took Korean classes overseas, about 50% more than five years earlier. Korean was taught at 2,777 schools in 47 countries.
cards.hook: Korean classes are spreading far beyond Korea.

cards.english_title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion Fine
cards.korean_desc: 뉴멕시코 법원이 개인정보 사건과 관련해 메타에 250억 달러를 지급하라고 명령했습니다. 배심원단은 메타가 소비자에게 개인정보 보호를 잘못 알렸다고 판단했습니다.
cards.english_desc: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion in a data privacy case. A jury found that Meta misled consumers about protecting their data.
cards.hook: Privacy mistakes just became extraordinarily expensive.

cards.english_title: Early Voting Surges in Key Senate States
cards.korean_desc: 미국 상원 선거 결과를 좌우할 수 있는 여러 주에서 사전투표가 크게 늘었습니다. 텍사스에서는 2022년보다 74% 증가했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Early voting rose sharply in several states that could decide control of the US Senate. In Texas, it increased 74% from 2022.
cards.hook: Voters are lining up early for a high-stakes Senate battle.
